# clanker-ui

> shadcn/ui (Base UI, Nova style) for plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. No build step, no npm, no framework. Markup uses the shadcn data-slot parts; behavior comes from HTML attributes and needs no init call. Everything runs under a strict Content-Security-Policy with Trusted Types.

Start with the agent skill or the full reference. The catalog has, for each component, its group file, parts, attributes and allowed values, state attributes, events, keyboard keys, and a minimal markup example.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://bl4ko.github.io/clanker-ui/docs.md): files, load order, CSP
- [Components](https://bl4ko.github.io/clanker-ui/docs/components.md): list of components
- [Button](https://bl4ko.github.io/clanker-ui/docs/components/button.md): variants, sizes, button parts of other components
- [Button Group](https://bl4ko.github.io/clanker-ui/docs/components/button-group.md): joined buttons and separators

## Reference

- [Full reference](https://bl4ko.github.io/clanker-ui/llms-full.txt): usage, markup rules, JavaScript API, events, localization, security rules, and every component
- [Component catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bl4ko/clanker-ui/main/skills/clanker-ui/references/clanker-ui.json): JSON with parts, attributes, events, keyboard, examples, and docs links
- [Catalog schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bl4ko/clanker-ui/main/skills/clanker-ui/references/clanker-ui.schema.json): JSON Schema of the catalog
- [Agent skill](https://github.com/bl4ko/clanker-ui/tree/main/skills/clanker-ui): portable Agent Skill (SKILL.md) that adds clanker-ui to a project
- [Contributor guide for agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bl4ko/clanker-ui/main/AGENTS.md): build, test, and code rules of the repository

## Optional

- [Releases](https://github.com/bl4ko/clanker-ui/releases): kit files, .min group files, zip, SHA256SUMS
- [Demo](https://bl4ko.github.io/clanker-ui/demo/): every component on one page
- [Source](https://github.com/bl4ko/clanker-ui)
